name: Create Jira issues for critical NorthDuty journey failures

parameters.content:
## Create Jira issues for critical NorthDuty journey failures

This workflow is for product, ecommerce, support, and agency teams that manage customer-facing website incidents in Jira. It turns a failed NorthDuty browser journey into an actionable Jira issue without asking someone to copy details out of an alert.

NorthDuty runs journeys such as checkout, signup, login, and form submission in a real browser. The trigger in this template listens only for **critical user journey failures** on the project you select. The Edit Fields node prepares a concise issue summary and a description with the affected website, NorthDuty incident ID, failure message, detection time, and dashboard link. Jira then creates the issue in the project and issue type you choose.

### Setup
1. Add NorthDuty API credentials and select the monitored project.
2. Add Jira credentials, then select the Jira project and issue type.
3. Activate the workflow so NorthDuty can register the webhook.

The trigger requires a NorthDuty plan with webhook notification channels and a public HTTPS webhook URL. To customize it, change the NorthDuty alert filters, add an IF or Switch node for client-specific routing, or map the NorthDuty severity into Jira priority. The NorthDuty incident ID is included in every description to make repeated reports easy to identify.

### 1. Select the monitored website
Add NorthDuty credentials and choose the project. The trigger is already limited to critical user journey failures.

### 2. Choose the Jira destination
Connect Jira, then select the project and issue type. You can also map severity to priority or add labels in Additional Fields.
